name: reoon_verify
description: Verify a single email address with Reoon. "power" mode (default) runs a real SMTP handshake and returns an explicit catch-all flag + a 0-100 score; "quick" mode skips SMTP for a faster, cheaper, less certain check. Example: reoon_verify({ email: "jane@stripe.com", mode: "power", _apiKey: "your-reoon-key" })

mode.description: Verification mode. Default "power" (SMTP handshake, catch-all detection, 0-100 score). "quick" is faster and cheaper but has no catch-all flag.

_apiKey.description: Your Reoon Email Verifier API key (create one at emailverifier.reoon.com -> API Settings).
